subject.title: Add DI composition root and navigation/activation seam for tray view models

question: Should the tray adopt `AppServiceRegistration`, `IUiDispatcher`, and `NavigationScopeManager` as the authoritative DI, UI-dispatch, and page-lifetime model before the first page is migrated to view models?
rationale: The patch is intentionally additive and well-covered, but selecting durable ownership boundaries for future tray work is an architectural direction decision rather than a mechanical correctness question.

options.title: Sponsor the seam and merge
options.body: Adopt the documented ownership model now, keeping future page conversions constrained to these single owners.

options.title: Defer the foundation
options.body: Keep the current tray architecture unchanged until a concrete page migration can justify and validate the permanent DI/navigation contracts.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the seam and merge
recommendation.body: Adopt the documented ownership model now, keeping future page conversions constrained to these single owners.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the most directly connected collaborator in the available history, having authored the proposed ownership transfer and its validation.
